<function name="UseAssaultBehavior" parent="NPC" type="classfunc">
	<realm>Server</realm>
	<description> Enables the AI's [Assault Behavior](https://developer.valvesoftware.com/wiki/Assault "Assault Behavior") when an `ai_goal_assault` is set for this SENT. 
<note>This function only works on `ai` type [SENTs](Scripted_Entities).</note>
	</description>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="boolean">Whether the action succeeded.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
